name: Is it possible to install new flooring over existing bathroom tile?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to install new flooring over existing bathroom tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing new flooring over existing bathroom tile is sometimes possible, but it depends on the condition of the current tile and the subfloor. The existing tile must be sound, level, and free of significant cracks or loose pieces. Laying new flooring, such as luxury vinyl planks or thinner tiles, can save on demolition costs and time. However, it will raise the floor height, which can create issues with door clearances, toilet flange height, and shower curb transitions. A professional assessment is recommended to determine feasibility and potential complications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing new flooring over existing bathroom tile is possible if the old tile is sound and level, but it can raise floor height and require professional assessment.
